query:
-- Schritt 1: Flag für alle 353 Beispiel-Prüfer:innen setzen
UPDATE users 
SET is_fictitious_example = 1
WHERE role = 'examiner' 
AND (loginMethod IS NULL OR loginMethod = 'NULL')
AND openId REGEXP '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{2}';

-- Schritt 2: Verknüpfte Tabellen bereinigen (examiner_programmes, examiner_email_templates)
DELETE ep FROM examiner_programmes ep
JOIN users u ON u.id = ep.examiner_id
WHERE u.is_fictitious_example = 1
AND u.id NOT IN (
  SELECT id FROM (
    SELECT id FROM users 
    WHERE role = 'examiner' AND is_fictitious_example = 1
    ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 60
  ) AS keep60
);

DELETE eet FROM examiner_email_templates eet
JOIN users u ON u.id = eet.examiner_id
WHERE u.is_fictitious_example = 1
AND u.id NOT IN (
  SELECT id FROM (
    SELECT id FROM users 
    WHERE role = 'examiner' AND is_fictitious_example = 1
    ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 60
  ) AS keep60
);

-- Schritt 3: 293 überschüssige Beispiel-Prüfer:innen löschen
DELETE FROM users
WHERE is_fictitious_example = 1
AND id NOT IN (
  SELECT id FROM (
    SELECT id FROM users 
    WHERE role = 'examiner' AND is_fictitious_example = 1
    ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 60
  ) AS keep60
);
